name: mixed_v1
decided_by: maintainer brief 2026-10-26 (Next Experiment: Mixed Calibration 2x Independent Design): the 2x profile is 1x supporting + 1x fluid, 50/50 by realized calibration positions, every P10.2 axis in the fluid half; 4x = 2x supporting + 2x fluid, a nested extension under the same draw. This file is the agent's $0 design; it authorizes nothing
question: Under D4-Augmented's recovery and evaluation exactly, does the Top-1 of a formal D1 full search calibrated on one mixed profile (supporting + fluid over all five P10.2 axes, 50/50 by realized scored positions) recover better static fluid correctness than D4 Top-1?

pool._why: the verified teacher-native pool historical D4's profiles were drawn from: 506 static fluid units, 13 interactive episodes and 6,020 supporting units, every item <= 8,192 rendered tokens. No new teacher data: the brief forbids generating it this round

fluid.quota: dose's fluid nominal / 5 per axis; a static axis splits it equally over its generators (one cell per generator); the interactive axis is ONE cell pooling both generators, so its quota is not doubled by the at-least-one-unit rule; within a cell the rule families are interleaved, so n units span min(n, families) families
fluid._interactive: an episode (unit_id) is taken or left whole, every turn item with it; base_pool_v1 has 13 episodes from 3 calibration rule families (8.3k-27.0k scored positions each), so at these doses the at-least-one-episode rule, not the quota, sets the interactive size

supporting.quota: the fluid half's REALIZED scored positions, split equally over the four subtypes; each cell stops at the prefix of its order whose total is nearest its quota (at least one unit), so the halves are 50/50 by realized positions to within half a unit per cell
supporting._why: the same four supporting groups historical D4's profiles drew (knowledge-dependent: learned math procedure, multi-hop and evidence reading); code and tool_calling stay out as they did in D4's calibration, and no closed-book factual QA source exists among the verified teacher-native data

4x.role: audited, not searched: the nested extension the 4x entry criterion would search

labels.subtype: fluid: the item's P10.2 axis; supporting: its source group
labels._why: DEPTH's objective is an unweighted mean over domain labels of an unweighted mean over subtypes of per-item KL (equal_subtype_then_equal_domain/v1). With the half as the domain, DEPTH weights supporting and fluid 1/2 each and every fluid axis 1/10; with the historical axis-as-domain labels it would weight supporting 1/6. FFN, RESIDUAL_WIDTH and ATTENTION pool their statistics over scored positions, so the realized position split is their weight

seed_derivation: uint32_be(sha256('stage0.calibration_volume.mixed_v1|draw|1')[:4]) mod 2**31: ONE draw for both doses, declared before any profile is built; never re-drawn
sample_rule: stratified nested sampling: per cell an order that interleaves its rule families (families in a seed-keyed order, each family's units in a seed-keyed order, one unit per family per round), whole units taken from the front (at least one); a fluid cell until its quota of scored positions is met, then each supporting cell to the prefix nearest its share of the fluid half's REALIZED positions; 4x takes a longer prefix of the same orders, so 2x is contained in 4x (build_mixed_profiles.py)

inherited: dev_v1 and final evaluation families (generator family split)

d4_augmented_members.what: every session D4-Augmented trained or validated on: E1's 2.96M training prefix and 16 validation sequences, and the fluid increment's admitted sessions; a pool unit is excluded when it shares a session id, a source id or a prompt key with any of them
d4_augmented_members._why: the recovery data must not double as the new arm's calibration data. The base pool predates the 2.96M rung: 1,713 of its 6,020 supporting units share a session, source or prompt with D4-Augmented's training or validation sets, and D4 Top-1's own calibration drew 8 of them (base_d4: 8 items, 7,457 of its 203,726 scored positions; rh_d4: 3 of those 8). No fluid unit of the pool is a member

exclusions.eval_set: eval-set-1 held-out units, by the frozen Stage-2 isolation rules R0-R9 (stages.reasoning_data.isolation_check.check_pool, historical pool); a unit an R1 or R2 check flags is excluded

search.declared_change: the forward baseline's free variable 'calibration profile per operator' has ONE value: every operator calibrates on the mixed 2x profile. The beam tree is then 4 + 12 + 12 + 6 = 34 expansions instead of the historical two-profile 8 + 48 + 24 + 12 = 92. Operator order (all 24 orders reachable), beam.delayed_prune@v1 width 6 warmup 1, beam.pareto_multi_objective@v2, state_eval@v1, positions.supervised_target_v1@v1, reference_topk_tail_v1 K=200, micro-batch 3, length_sorted_v1 and scored_v1 are unchanged
search._execution: the bit-identical execution options historical D4's search ran with (search_record.json :: execution)
